docs.title: agentcausal Documentation
docs.text: agentcausal is a Python library for multi-turn causal attribution, counterfactual guardrail evaluation, and anytime-valid statistical auditing of large language model (LLM) agents.

docs.title: Key Capabilities
docs.text:
• Sequential Doubly-Robust Off-Policy Evaluation (SequentialDROPE): Cross-fitted DR, WDR, DM, IS, and WIS estimators for multi-turn conversational trajectories under time-varying confounding, plus exact telescoping turn-level causal attribution.
  • Counterfactual Guardrail Mediation (GuardrailDecomposer): Multiply-robust efficient influence function (EIF) separation of Natural Direct Effects (NDE) and Natural Indirect Over-Refusal Effects (NIE), plus counterfactual safety-utility Pareto frontier tracing.
  • Anytime-Valid Sequential Auditing (AnytimeAuditor): Predictable plug-in betting e-processes and empirical-Bernstein confidence sequences with Ville's inequality Type-I error guarantees under arbitrary optional stopping.
  • Nonparametric Exposure Auditing (ExposureAuditor): Model-free GPU/CPU leave-one-model-out peer-matched hard-tail exposure shift detection with anytime-valid betting e-values.

See the Tutorial for runnable workflows and the API Reference for detailed class signatures.

docs.title: 1. Multi-Turn Doubly-Robust Off-Policy Evaluation & Turn Attribution
docs.text:
from agentcausal import SequentialDROPE, simulate_multiturn_agent

dataset = simulate_multiturn_agent(n_trajectories=2000, horizon=5, seed=42)
evaluator = SequentialDROPE(n_folds=5, device="auto", random_state=42)
res = evaluator.evaluate(dataset)
print("DR estimate:", res.estimate, "SE:", res.se, "95% CI:", (res.ci_low, res.ci_high))

attr = evaluator.attribute_turns(dataset)
print("Per-turn causal lift:", attr.turn_effects)
print("Exact additivity error:", attr.additivity_error)

docs.title: 2. Guardrail Path-Specific Decomposition & Safety-Utility Frontier
docs.text:
import numpy as np
from agentcausal import GuardrailDecomposer, simulate_guardrail_mediation

med = simulate_guardrail_mediation(n_samples=3000, seed=42)
dec = GuardrailDecomposer(n_folds=5, random_state=42)
res = dec.decompose(med["contexts"], med["guardrail"], med["mediator"], med["utility"])
print(f"ATE={res.ate:+.4f}, NDE={res.nde:+.4f}, NIE={res.nie:+.4f}")

frontier = dec.pareto_frontier(
    contexts=med["contexts"],
    guardrail=med["guardrail"],
    safety_outcome=med["safety"],
    utility_outcome=med["utility"],
    risk_scores=med["risk_scores"],
    thresholds=np.linspace(0.1, 0.9, 9),
)
for pt in frontier:
    print(f"tau={pt.threshold:.2f} safety={pt.safety_rate:.3f} utility={pt.utility_rate:.3f}")

docs.title: 3. Continuous Deployment Monitoring with Anytime-Valid e-Values
docs.text:
from agentcausal import AnytimeAuditor

auditor = AnytimeAuditor(alpha=0.05, lower=0.0, upper=1.0)
res = auditor.audit(med["safety"], null_mean=0.50, alternative="greater")
print("Rejected:", res.rejected, "Stopping time:", res.stopping_time)
print("Final 95% time-uniform CS:", (res.cs_low[-1], res.cs_high[-1]))

docs.title: 4. Nonparametric Benchmark Exposure Auditing
docs.text:
from agentcausal import ExposureAuditor, load_openllm_slice

sl = load_openllm_slice()
exp = ExposureAuditor(hard_threshold=0.20, device="auto").audit(
    responses=sl["responses"],
    model_names=sl["model_names"],
    benchmark_ids=sl["benchmark_ids"],
)
for row in exp.top_flagged(5):
    print(row["rank"], row["model"], f"delta={row['delta']:+.3f}", f"log10E={row['log10_e']:.2f}")
